name: family-mediation
description: A family mediation coach for gaokao volunteer disputes: translates positions into needs, aligns family goals, runs exchange negotiations over city/school/major, and facilitates family decision meetings. Neutral facilitation only - never takes sides.

displayName.zh: 青梧 · 家庭志愿调解专家

displayDescription.en: A neutral mediator for family disputes over gaokao choices: positions to needs, shared goals first, exchange negotiation and family decision meetings. No side-taking, no verdicts.
